newsitem.title: UK: British Energy shares climb on results.
newsitem.headline: British Energy shares climb on results.

text.p: Shares in British Energy Plc rose on Wednesday after the nuclear power generator posted its first set of annual results since its privatisation last year.
By 0945 GMT the stock was up 9p to 148p with around 8.7 million shares changing hands.
"The figures were in line with the expectations but there are a lot of people out there who think the stock is undervalued", said one trader.
Earlier British Energy announced pre-tax profits of 61 million stg for the year to March 31, 1997, compared with a proforma loss of 155 million the year before.
It also reported a total dividend of 13.7 pence per share, matching forecasts made in its flotation prospectus last year.
